edges.needs: the sector and every placed sector whose center is within twice the half diagonal of a sector's edge plus the nearest-systems search distance of its center (`store._sectors_near`, the sectors `refresh_nearest_systems` reads)
edges.unit_params: the run's own sector ids as `sector_ids` and the unit's sector as `chunk` (never `since`: the sectors saved since a time are the ones saved so far, and `skip` must be the whole run)

edges.needs: the sector and every placed sector whose center is within `NEIGHBOUR_REACH_EDGES` edges of its center along each axis (`sector_paths._neighbour_centers`, the point masses a body's path sees)
edges.unit_params: the unit's sector as `sector_ids` with `workers` 1 (the cut's `expand` of the sectors around is the edge's job: each of them is its own unit)
